## Applications, premises and first remaining obligation

`native_reader_equations`, `formal_reader_equation`, `local_source_lookup`, `source_lambda_reader`, `complete_permission_inventory`, `catch_reader_equation` and `resolved_operation_reader` expose exactly the native lookup/list premises of the constructed readers. `constructed_internal_characterization` specializes existing R45 acceptance to the constructed inputs; it is an equivalence, not an assumed concrete source instance. `concrete_existing_internal_extraction` actually discharges the existing sourceLambda and R45 extraction checks on primitive records, preserving the full permission payload `[7,7,11]`. `constructed_internal_application` and its concrete instance apply R45's constructor/endpoints theorem to those same values.

`withSource` replaces only source/selection in an explicitly supplied parent context. `constructed_known_unmatched` applies the R49 classifier to these constructed source tables; its independent provider sourceOperation read remains an explicit hypothesis. `constructed_known_unmatched_forward` applies the existing Forward theorem, additionally retaining the independent providerCandidate/native endpoint read. It constructs no provider/path/arrival tables. The concrete source-classification witness reuses R49's existing parent fixture only for those explicitly outside-fragment inputs; it is not a complete Context constructed from Rust.

First unavailable source premise for completing the parent application: construct the corresponding R48 provider-origin `sourceOperation` read and R49 native `providerCandidate`/physical-or-support path tables from the same retained owner, with complete owner-preserving primitive extraction. Those readers lie outside this admitted source/Internal fragment. No FaithfulExtraction-equivalent predicate or default reader was assumed. Even this fragment's Rust-to-Lean field encoding and complete successful runtime extraction remain source/native correspondence obligations for independent review; the Lean equations show what must commute, not that Rust ran. R50 whole-context interpretation, R51/R52 primitive tables, source preservation, full hygiene, soundness, principality, termination, runtime and production remain OPEN. The original parent is not weakened.

Falsifiers checked: original LocalSource index0 yielding Lambda occurrence17 vs schedule entry999; missing/duplicate permissions, constructors, receipts, facts, recipes and formal records; mismatched route endpoints; missing/duplicate/wrong-constructor/foreign raw child; exact artifact identity; raw entry4 versus44 even under equal canonical image; reordered Catch arms; duplicate operation resolutions; same-spelling foreign declaration; and an unresolved unselected later arm. KnownUnmatched Forward is proved with the explicit independent native-read premise.

    formals := fun index => (n.formals[index]?).bind (fun f => f.nativeRoot.map (fun root => (formal f, root)))

Audit4 failed on wrong field spellings (`parameterRecipes/sourceOwners` versus existing R39 `recipes/owners`), attempting decidable equality of a function-valued Inputs record, and the namespace of Endpoint. Its diagnostics and elaborator-recovery `sorryAx` outputs are preserved and rejected; no such proof is delivered. Audit5 repaired these issues but retained one unused-simp warning. Audit6 removed that warning and is the final exact-byte accepted audit. The delivered module contains no sorry/admit/project axiom/native_decide/skipKernelTC.
